{{Quote|Most people associate the Atrisian Empire with exotic danger&mdash;the brutal conquests of its early rulers, the brilliant but ruthless political gambits of Emperor Uueg Tching, the distilled political craftiness of his ''Sayings'', or the sociopathic decadence of the Six Savage Viziers. While the modern Atrisian Commonwealth is a far more mundane place, Atrisian script ''[&hellip;]'' has found a place offworld in hands every bit as pitiless as the ancient emperors.|Doctor Milanda Vorgan, "The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic"|<ref name="Written">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>}}
The '''Atrisian Commonwealth''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] located on the edge of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. Containing around 200 [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], the sector included the planets [[Atrisia/Legends|Atrisia]] and [[Frisal]] as well as the [[Kiliea system/Legends|Kiliea system]], the origin point of the [[Kiliean bolt gun]]s. Frisal was a reserve world of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the eight-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] [[loirbnigg]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptilians]].

The Atrisian Commonwealth came into being at some point by [[3996 BBY]] as a civilization independent from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By that [[Time/Legends|time]], the Commonwealth included Atrisia, which was home to an ancient race of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] known as [[Atrisian]]s. The region was a member of the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and Atrisia also fell within the borders of the Galactic Empire a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later. Human natives of the Commonwealth at that time included [[Rom Mohc]] and [[Villis Andal]].

At some point following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the Atrisian Commonwealth joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] as an [[Allied Region]]. Around [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], the [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] [[Henrietya Antilles|Corellia Antilles]] speculated that recovering the missing original manuscript of the ''[[Sayings]]'', an ancient Atrisian document, would help improve the New Republic-Commonwealth relations. Almost [[38 ABY|three decades]] later, the [[Xenolinguist/Legends|xenolinguist]] [[Milanda Vorgan]] characterized the Atrisian Commonwealth as being a relatively mundane locale by that time.

==Description==
The Atrisian Commonwealth was a region located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. A narrow slice of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] lying on the very edge of those larger regions, it contained approximately 200 [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. The Core portion of the Commonwealth included the [[Atrisi system]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Frisal system/Legends|Frisal system]], and the [[Kiliea system/Legends|Kiliea system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The Atrisi [[Star system/Legends|system]] lay at the endpoint of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Giju Run/Legends|Giju Run]], which connected it to the Core Worlds' [[Dahrtag system/Legends|Dahrtag system]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Atrisi system contained the terrestrial planet [[Atrisia/Legends|Atrisia]],<ref name="IS2">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> also known as Kitel Phard, and the Frisal system was the site of<ref name="TEA" /> a terrestrial<ref name="Planets">''[[The Star Wars Planets Collection]]''</ref> world<ref name="CSWE Frisal">{{CSWECite|I|296|Frisal}}</ref> of the [[Frisal|same name]]. The latter was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[loirbnigg]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of eight-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] creatures.<ref name="Planets" />

==History==
===Joining the Republic===
[[File:TapaniOversector-EGTW.png|thumb|right|250px|Atrisia was a member of the Galactic Republic by the time of the Clone Wars.]]
At some point, the [[Atrisian|inhabitants]] of the planet Atrisia developed interstellar spaceflight, and the world became a part of the independent civilization known as the Atrisian Commonwealth. The area of space surrounding the Artisi system was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at some point between [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] and [[3996 BBY]] and thus became part of what was considered the civilized [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Contact with the Atrisian Commonwealth led to the growth of the Southern Core region.<ref name="TEA" />

Despite space surrounding Atrisia being a part of the territories either unaligned with or contested by the Republic or the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] by [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the planet fell within the borders of the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the first campaigns of that conflict, the [[Twentieth Army]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] was tasked with defending Atrisia's vicinity against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Atrisia lay within space controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

===New Republic and beyond===
{{Quote|Recovery of the ''Sayings'' manuscript would be of great help in improving relations with the Atrisian Commonwealth.|Lecture by Doctor Corellia Antilles|<ref name="Files">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>}}
[[File:Uueg_Tching_Sayings_SWAJ14.png|thumb|left|250px|Doctor Corellia Antilles believed that the recovery of the missing original manuscript of the ''Sayings'' would improve the relations between the New Republic and the Atrisian Commonwealth.]]
Following the death of Palpatine at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Atrisia declared its independence from the Empire, and the Atrisian Commonwealth eventually joined the Empire's successor government, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], as an [[Allied Region]].<ref name="TEA" /> In a lecture given at the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]] on<ref name="Files" /> the Core Worlds planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Files" /> around [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="11 ABY">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}} is set shortly after the re-establishment of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] following the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|final defeat]] of the resurrected [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].</ref> the [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Henrietya Antilles|Corellia Antilles]] described the original manuscript of the ''[[Sayings]]''&mdash;a [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-old collection of instructional texts from the era when Atrisia was still being unified. The manuscript had been transferred from Atrisia to Coruscant [[1 BBY/Legends|twelve years]] prior, and during the New Republic [[Core Campaign|advance]] on the latter planet, the document disappeared when artifacts were evacuated from<ref name="Files" /> the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]].<ref name="TEA" /> Antilles went further on to state that the recovery of the ''Sayings'' manuscript would greatly improve the New Republic relations with the Atrisian Commonwealth.<ref name="Files" />

The [[Xenolinguist/Legends|xenolinguist]] Doctor [[Milanda Vorgan]] noted in<ref name="Written" /> her<ref name="TT">{{WEGCite|story=Erasing All Traces|book=The Last Command Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref> [[38 ABY]] publication "[[The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic]]" that the state of the Atrisian Commonwealth by that [[Time/Legends|time]] was relatively uneventful, especially when compared with the exotic danger associated by many people with the ancient [[Atrisian Empire]].<ref name="Written" /> By [[137 ABY]], Atrisia had been incorporated into the [[Core Worlds Security Zone]], an administrative territory of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|It's no surprise that General Rom Mohc, a native of the Atrisian Commonwealth, chose the Orinackra detention facility to house the would-be defector Crix Madine.|Doctor Milanda Vorgan, "The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic"|<ref name="Written" />}}
[[File:Mohc_Star_Wars_TCG.png|thumb|right|250px|Rom Mohc was a native of the Atrisian Commonwealth.]]
Atrisia was colonized by [[Human/Legends|Humans]],<ref name="TEA" /> who were generally thought to have evolved on Coruscant.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Despite eventually achieving interstellar spaceflight, the Atrisians remained an insular culture, although some left their homeworld for the wider [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]],<ref name="TEA" /> such as [[Rom Mohc]],<ref name="Written" /> who served with the Republic Military during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref>

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], there were several [[Noble/Legends|noble]] families of Atrisians, one of which included [[Villis Andal]], who eventually became a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the Galactic Empire. Some of the pastimes of the young Atrisian nobles, Andal included, were riding loirbniggs and studying the use of [[Kiliean bolt gun]]s,<ref name="Planets">''[[The Star Wars Planets Collection]]''</ref> weapons which originated in the Kiliea system.<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Kiliean bolt gun]]|system=[[Kiliea system/Legends|Kiliea system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

The Empire maintained Frisal as a preserve world for affluent Imperial families.<ref name="CSWE Frisal" /> Members of the Imperial nobility also vacationed on the planet, and the aristocrats<ref name="CSWE Loirbnigg">{{CSWECite|II|259|loirbnigg}}</ref> [[Reproduction/Legends|bred]]<ref name="CSWE Frisal" /> and trained loirbniggs for use as mounts.<ref name="CSWE Loirbnigg" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Atrisia's antiquity and apparent importance to galactic culture argued for putting it in the Core Worlds; we stuck it out on the frontier to give it more of a whiff of the exotic and in hopes that future Star Wars creators might find intriguing possibilities in that.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Blog">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2009/08/endnotes-for-star-wars-essential-atlas_24.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 2 of 5)}}</ref>}}
[[File:SWAJ14.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Atrisian Commonwealth was first mentioned in ''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 14.]]
The Atrisian Commonwealth was first mentioned in [[Timothy S. O'Brien|Timothy O'Brien's]] article "[[From the Files of Corellia Antilles]]," which was published as part of the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 14|fourteenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' in [[August]] [[1997]].<ref name="Files" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' provided the first visual depiction of the sector on a map created by [[Modi]].<ref name="TEA" />

"[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine, had previously placed the Atrisi system in the [[Harron sector/Legends|Harron sector]]. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> it was considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> Ultimately, ''The Essential Atlas'' overrode the ''Voyages SF'' placement by establishing that the Atrisi system was situated outside of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="TEA" /> in which the Harron sector was later placed.<ref name="Expansion">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region}}</ref> The book also placed the Atrisian Commonwealth in grid squares J-12 and J-13.<ref name="TEA" />

When writing ''The Essential Atlas'', the authors [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] placed the planet Atrisia<ref name="Blog" /> and a part of the Atrisian Commonwealth<ref name="TEA" /> in the Core Worlds region of the galaxy due to previously published sources noting the planet's antiquity and its cultural importance to the wider galaxy. However, they also placed it on the very frontier of that region, near the border of the explored galactic territories.<ref name="TEA" /> This was done intentionally to make Atrisia seem a more exotic location and to provide the authors of future ''[[Star Wars]]'' media with interesting storytelling possibilities.<ref name="Blog" />
